subject: Slate guidance & anchor questions: Staff Inference - alignment request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slate guidance & anchor questions: Staff Inference - alignment request

Hi team,

We're starting to move a small slate of Staff Inference candidates into loop this month. Before we send invites and hand over to interviewers, can we schedule a short alignment to: 

- Clarify the role boundaries (serving runtime vs. model infra ownership)
- Set leveling expectations (what constitutes Staff vs. Senior)
- Agree 4–6 anchor questions per slot (system design, inference perf, reliability/troubleshooting, cross-team collaboration)
- Timebox debriefs and pass/fail criteria for each slot

I've attached the candidate pack and a proposed rubric (proposed-rubric-v3.xlsx) with my rough anchors. Would like to keep this to 45 minutes and leave with a deliverable: final rubric + a one-page debrief checklist for interviewers.

Availability I have: Wed 3/11 10–11a, Thu 3/12 2–4p PT. Please reply with what works; Hannah, would you be willing to chair? Markus — would be great if you can cover bar-raiser perspective.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
attachments: staff-inference-candidate-pack.pdf, proposed-rubric-v3.xlsx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slate guidance & anchor questions: Staff Inference - alignment request

Thanks Marissa — happy to chair. Wed 3/11 10–10:45a PT works for me; I'll block 45 minutes and aim for a sharp agenda. Quick notes before we meet: 

1) Role scope: recommend we explicitly call out "inference serving ownership" as primary and "model release cadence" as secondary. We want candidates who can operate at both the infra and product tradeoff level.
2) Leveling: Staff = drives cross-team inference SLAs, mentors scaling patterns, defines cost/latency tradeoffs at program level. Senior = owns feature-level delivery + optimizations.
3) Interview slots: 60m total candidate loop -> we should still timebox interviewer segments to 30/30/30 depending on panels; but for calibration session let's focus on 3 slots:
   - System design & architecture (30m)
   - Inference perf & optimization (30m)
   - Ownership & cross-team collaboration (20m)
4) Deliverables: final rubric + one-pager debrief checklist + 6 canonical anchor questions (2 per slot)

I'll prepare a short one-pager (scoring-scale-one-pager.pdf) that normalizes our 1–4 scale so debriefs are comparable. Markus, will you keep an eye out for anything we should include as a bar-raiser red flag (e.g., inability to reason about KV cache tradeoffs under tail latency)?

See you Wed. Adding a placeholder calendar invite.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Talent Operations — Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slate guidance & anchor questions: Staff Inference - alignment request

On Tue, Mar 10, 2026 at 10:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll prepare a short one-pager (scoring-scale-one-pager.pdf) that normalizes our 1–4 scale so debriefs are comparable. Markus, will you keep an eye out for anything we should include as a bar-raiser red flag...?

Happy to. A couple quick suggestions ahead of the sync so we can move fast: 

- Use anchored behavioral probes ("tell me about a time you reduced tail latency by X") instead of purely hypothetical prompts for the ownership slot.
- Scoring: prefer a 1–5 scale with descriptors at 1/3/5 and guidance for 2/4 — gives more granularity without being subjective. I'll bring a one-slide scoring mapping I use.
- Debrief flow: start with quick signal (pass/concern), then evidence bullets, then calibration note if needed. We should reserve 3 minutes per interviewer to call out "must-ask follow-ups" for the next round.

Attachments: scoring-scale-one-pager.pdf (draft), bar-raiser-checklist-draft.docx

I'd also like to run a 10-minute simulated debrief during the meeting with a past anonymized candidate note so we align on language.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Staff Inference Lead (bar-raiser)

Thanks — Rebecca from TalentBridge here. Quick note from the recruiter side: we currently have four candidates in the active slate (two internal referrals, two sourced). Before your calibration, can you confirm: 

- Which candidate profiles should get the full Staff loop vs. an accelerated Senior loop?
- Are there any non-negotiable topics to surface in scheduling (e.g., travel, take-home work)?

I can hold interview invites pending final rubric. Also attaching the candidate roster (anonymized) for your reference.

Best,
Rebecca

All — confirmed for Thu 3/12 2:00–2:45p PT (updated calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-meet-id). Agenda below and deliverables listed at the top so we leave with them.

Agenda (45m):
- 0–5m: Goals + deliverables (final rubric, 1-pg debrief checklist, 6 anchor Qs)
- 5–20m: Role scope & leveling (Marissa + Laura)
- 20–35m: Anchor questions & scoring anchors (Markus leads) — pick top 2 per slot
- 35–43m: Simulated debrief (Markus)
- 43–45m: Next steps & owner assignments (Hannah)

Deliverables owner:
- Final rubric: Marissa + Hannah (deadline Fri 3/13 EOD)
- Debrief 1-pager: Markus (draft by Thu EOD)
- Canonical anchor Qs: Laura + Markus (finalized in meeting)

Rebecca — for scheduling, let's run the two strongest profiles through the full Staff loop; run the other two for Senior unless hiring manager asks to elevate. No take-homes for this round; we prefer live/problem-solving.

Attachments included in this thread: staff-inference-candidate-pack.pdf, proposed-rubric-v3.xlsx, scoring-scale-one-pager.pdf

Thanks everyone — see you in the meeting.

—Hannah
